# DATA4ME

> Fast and affordable VTU platform for buying data, airtime, cable TV subscriptions and electricity tokens in Nigeria.

DATA4ME is a product of DEST-GLOBAL LIMITED (D4 TECH), serving customers across all 36 Nigerian states starting from Delta State. We provide instant data bundles, airtime top-ups, cable TV renewals and electricity bill payments through a secure wallet system.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Overview of DATA4ME services and pricing highlights
- [About](/about): Company mission, coverage and team behind DATA4ME
- [Pricing](/pricing): Data bundle and airtime pricing across MTN, Glo, Airtel and 9mobile
- [Networks](/networks): Supported mobile networks and coverage details
- [Buy Data](/buy-data): Purchase data bundles for all Nigerian networks
- [Buy Airtime](/buy-airtime): Purchase airtime top-ups for all Nigerian networks
- [Cable TV](/cable): Renew DStv, GOtv and Startimes subscriptions
- [Electricity](/electricity): Pay electricity bills and buy prepaid tokens
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about delivery, refunds and supported services
- [Contact](/contact): Support channels and business enquiries
